info.title: CryptoOS API
info.description: Read-only research API. No order-execution surface exists in v1 (PD-1). Errors use the envelope {error:{code,message,detail}}.

get.description: The instrument registry (PD-12: scopes name these explicitly).

post.description: Queue an ingest/backfill job; execution happens in the background task.
Queue a refetch of one stored gap (section 4.6: refetch, re-assess, re-derive).

get.description: Latest quality per (instrument, timeframe) + the exclusions still active.
Every stored exclusion interval (section 4.6: reports list all of them).

schema.title: Response Data Gaps V1 Data Gaps Get

get.description: The stored manifest: source files, hashes, row counts, version fields (AC2).
Closed bars for one (instrument, timeframe) window (spec section 11).

Server-computed indicator over the same window as /v1/candles (D-011).

Name and params fail fast (422) before any I/O: unknown names,
undocumented keys and missing documented defaults are never guessed.

Closed-bar events for one (instrument, timeframe) window (section 6.2).

Detector/version/params resolve through the registry and
``config/defaults.yaml`` (PD-11); the window resolution is exactly the
candles path so provenance matches.
Documented defaults (PD-11): the file the API resolves parameters against.
